comparison.objective: Clear a jammed printer card with both hands and resume printing; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated bimanual traction on a resisting sheet/card while avoiding tearing and restoring printer operation versus small-tool access, collar rotation, and iterative impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Jam must be removed intact and printing resumed; candidate instead requires two safe, repeatable carriage stops under numeric physical limits.
comparison.reason: Jammed-media extraction and restoration test a different physical ability and end state.
